authorization_event_ref.description: Exact native Device or Agent runtime endpoint authorization Event. This establishes the endpoint key instance, not scope read or disclosure permission.

signature_key_base64url.description: MLS endpoint signature key bound by the applicable original creator, Add or recovery authority. An Event producer key may differ only with an independently verified native endpoint-to-leaf binding; equating the two keys or trusting caller-supplied leaf ownership is forbidden.

source_event_ref.description: Exact authenticated immutable original Event, with independently verified Commit, producer and original group provenance. Not a materialized Message or current edit.

content_path.description: RFC6901 pointer rooted at source_event_ref. Ending at a registered encrypted envelope selects its 16-byte DEK. Descending through an envelope first authenticates and parses its registered plaintext with a separately authorized parent key; an authenticated encrypted_attachment descriptor selects its 32-byte DEK. Arrays use canonical nonnegative decimal indices, never append or leading zeros. No implicit parent-key disclosure, root fallback or current MLS state restoration. See content-history section 4 and media-and-blob section 3.0.

history_grant.description: Original signed grant references an accepted ak.mls.history_request authored by its exact recipient endpoint. The complete recipient, recipient_hpke_key_base64url, history_cut and expires_at equal that request; endpoint authorization remains inside recipient. Issuer disclosure and recipient read authority are independently native-verified, not asserted by an opaque payload reference. HPKE info and aad equal JCS({recipient,recipient_hpke_key_base64url,recipient_key_event_ref,history_cut,expires_at,selector}). sealed_key_base64url is canonical unpadded base64url(enc[32] || ciphertext || tag[16]), exactly 64 or 80 decoded bytes for a 16/32-byte key. Default RFC9180 suite is X25519/HKDF-SHA256/ChaCha20Poly1305, mode Base, seq=0; no wire nonce.

recovery_preparation.description: Private unit-derived content-recovery preparation resource. The path authorization Event equals replacement.authorization_event_ref. Replacement is projected from the exact accepted Human recovery Device key or activated Agent pairing runtime key; no caller-selected key or second episode ID. pending has no inventory ref; prepared fixes the complete canonical inventory Blob and does not attest plaintext restoration or client history-ready. Current native subject holders and accepted current Agent history custodians only; no peer, anonymous or candidate disclosure.

history_request.description: Exact recipient-native-endpoint signed history request. Endpoint authorization is recipient.authorization_event_ref. Scope read authority is independently verified at the accepting RealmCommit cut and again for new grant issuance/delivery; this object is not a permission grant. Its endpoint key is the native verified MLS leaf key and may differ from the independently verified Event producer key. No top-level authorization_event_ref exists.

recovery_inventory.description: Private canonical Blob preimage, streamed/hashed without a global group-count truncation. Entries ordered by unsigned bytes of JCS({effective_scope,genesis_event_ref}), unique by that pair; old_leaves ordered by leaf_index. Includes empty scopes and exact native endpoint provenance; local Account Station durable membership/admission ledger is frozen at the recovery fence. Empty entries are valid only for a complete native census proving no activated MLS scope; an activated empty group still requires its real entry. The hash/schema alone never proves completeness. Complete native census includes every unresolved predecessor-episode scope even without a current leaf or membership; prepared bytes remain immutable and private native obligations remain associated.

scope_cleanup.description: Exactly one result for every inventory entry: rekeyed with actual winning transition and sufficient new roots, or removed/terminated with the exact governor-signed retirement proof. Root/backup/roster disclosure is forbidden in retirement results. Outer state/scope/genesis must equal the signed proof and inventory entry.

cleanup_inventory.description: Private canonical Blob preimage; scope_cleanups correspond one-for-one to all original inventory entries in the same order. Each entry has verified rekeyed, removed or irreversible terminated evidence. A departed scope is never omitted or rejoined. SHA256 domain is ak.content.cleanup_inventory.v1 followed by LF and JCS.

backup_source_attestation.description: Origin backup-keeper statement over the exact complete original Event and registered protection slots. The issuer verifies native accepted root storage, sufficient recipient and permanent retention from first PUT; a signer-only proof or copied ciphertext cannot issue this statement. The statement grants no writer, membership, read or migration authority.

recovery_scope_cleanup_request_body.description: Exact prepared episode and inventory entry. nonce_base64url is a stable native intent identity; delivery_challenge_base64url is fresh for each new observation. Both are canonical random 32-byte values. Outer idempotency always hashes the full request body. After current/native qualification, subject/episode/nonce durably reserves exact I even when first domain eligibility rejects; fresh delivery challenge cannot rebind I. Origin reservation is global across destinations and precedes source signing. Reservation alone installs no scope safety effect.

predecessor_authorization_event_refs.description: Canonical UTF-8 sorted exact prior recovery authorization refs for this Actor/scope, frozen with the prepared intent association. The qualified origin attests native full supersedes/generation causality to this replacement. Empty only when the complete census has no unresolved predecessor association. No private PCR originals or positions.

recovery_scope_cleanup_authorization.description: Native current origin authorization. Stable I contains exactly replacement, inventory_digest, inventory_entry and nonce_base64url. Current destination, delivery challenge, method, validity and signature are signed but excluded from I. They are included in the full outer request hash; no nonce-only canonical hash is permitted. After current/native qualification, subject/episode/nonce durably reserves exact I even when first domain eligibility rejects; fresh delivery challenge cannot rebind I. Origin reservation is global across destinations and precedes source signing. Reservation alone installs no scope safety effect. The origin-signed predecessor_authorization_event_refs is a frozen native association to I, excluded from its four-field digest but immutable across observations. The governor associates only retained exact same-Actor/scope/genesis obligations; no unsigned or caller-provided causal relation is accepted.

scope_retirement_proof.description: Governor-signed private native absence or irreversible terminal fact for one frozen recovery inventory entry. removed proves every displaced endpoint is absent after reconciliation and the episode fence; terminated proves a registered irreversible lifecycle and permanent no-future-content gate, not a fictional zero leaf count. No current membership, business history, other-member roster, root or backup is disclosed. The signature domain is ak.mls.scope_retirement.v1 followed by LF and JCS(proof without signature). scope_cut belongs to the target scope. terminal_source_digest binds an independently native-qualified direct or registered upstream terminal source; that private source can belong to another stream and is not disclosed by the proof.

recovery_scope_cleanup_response_body.description: Pending observation, or an immutable historical cleanup plus a fresh current-governor delivery attestation. Current rejoin does not deny delivery of an existing terminal. The original pending observation is immutable for the full-body retry and challenge; it does not freeze native intent settlement. A subsequent observation uses a fresh delivery challenge.

scope_retirement_delivery_attestation.description: Current-governor signed delivery of one immutable historical proof. It certifies native proof and monotone fence retention/import at delivery, binds the exact fresh origin authorization, challenge, stable intent and recipient Station, and never rewrites the original proof. Signature domain: ak.mls.scope_retirement_delivery.v1 plus LF and JCS(attestation without signature). Freshness applies at receipt, not as a global completion lease.
